title: Exact dependency closure: sealed SSC releases and entry-scoped legacy intake
summary: Two closure modes are explicit. SEALED consumes a QUALIFIED SSC deployment and its exact transitive dependency deployment ids without re-resolution. DEVELOPMENT/LEGACY_INTAKE starts from explicit entry packages and reachable package/source requirements, freezes the result before mutation, and must not be represented as a sealed release. Both feed a deterministic Deployment target namespace.
invariants: SEALED mode follows exact SSC deployment dependency ids and never chooses a newer provider during Deployment.
DEVELOPMENT/LEGACY_INTAKE starts from explicit entry packages so tests/examples do not become production dependencies merely by sharing an archive.
Every resolved closure is frozen before target mutation and retained as deployment evidence.
Missing, ambiguous or substituted required providers fail closed.
The semantic closure and target namespace receipt remain separately inspectable.
Hosted modules resolve their exact host/module closure before namespace materialisation, package-load, composition, activation and live probe.

provenance.claim: Defines sealed/development closure modes and target namespace boundary.
Current executable documentation for both closure paths and deterministic namespace.
